These pathways indicate that Buprenorphine may influence Cyp2c18 through different metabolic routes, both involving the cytochrome P450 family. The integration of these pathways suggests that Buprenorphine could modulate Cyp2c18's activity through enzyme participation, potentially affecting drug metabolism or other biochemical processes.
